key_facts: Referring a skin lesion through a **teledermatology or advice-and-guidance** service.
Images + history are **triaged by a dermatologist**, who can discharge, advise, book surgery directly or fast-track.

**Poor images**, missing dermoscopy, scalp / genital / nail lesions, and **delay** in a suspected melanoma pathway.

sections.title: Clinical features
blocks: NHS England's **A teledermatology roadmap** (2023) describes models:

ul: referral triage (images attached to all 2WW skin referrals)
community "image capture hubs" with trained medical photographers
AI-assisted triage (HTG746; see *Recognition, diagnostic accuracy, dermoscopy and AI*).

blocks.h: Image standards (BAD/PCDS/Primary Care Dermatology quality standards)

ul: **Three views:** a regional/whole-site image (anatomical location), a close-up with a **ruler/scale**, and a **dermoscopic image** (polarised, in focus, the whole lesion in view).

Good lighting, no flash glare, a plain background, a labelled patient ID, consent, and secure NHS-approved systems (**no personal phones/WhatsApp** without an approved app and policy). Include history (duration, change, symptoms, 7-point score, risk factors, Fitzpatrick type).

blocks: For lesion triage, accuracy is comparable to face-to-face assessment for many lesions when dermoscopic images are of good quality. It reduces unnecessary face-to-face appointments and speeds up the management of cancers. Image quality is the main failure mode. Darker skin types are under-represented in training.
Nodular/amelanotic melanoma can be under-called on. Teledermatology must not delay a 2WW-meeting referral; where a pathway uses, they **accompany** the urgent referral rather than replace it.

ul: Duration, **change**, symptoms, risk factors (sunburn, sunbeds, family history, immunosuppression), 7-point score.
Check focus and framing before sending.
Scalp, genitals, nails: may need face-to-face.
Learn the local teledermatology pathway and image capture standards. An IP in a PCN may capture images if trained.
**[Case 3](condition:melanoma):** a lesion changing over 2 years (change = 2, plus any other feature) → 2WW referral with. The specialist arranges excision biopsy within the pathway.

ladder.t: Local teledermatology pathway and image capture standards. IPs in a PCN may capture images if trained.
Changing lesion (change = 2 + any other) → 2WW **with images**; specialist arranges excision biopsy.
Explain photos may be reviewed first and they may be booked straight for surgery; consent for storage.

blocks.title: Prescribing limits and pitfalls
list: **Poor images**: Refer face to face rather than delay.

refer.t: Teledermatology must **not delay** a suspected cancer pathway: poor images → refer face to face.

sections.title: Red flags and when to refer

ul: Teledermatology must not delay a **suspected cancer pathway** referral: if images are poor, refer face to face.

pearls: Tell the patient that photos may be reviewed by a specialist first and they may be booked straight for surgery. Get consent for image storage.
